base_policy.statement: Original prepared provenance retained for explicitly listed compatibility fields only; target graph/text owner follows refreshed policy.

statement: Target F owns Default graph membership, ordered edges, groups, names, classification and complete supported CSD stat texts. Target supplemental tables own Ascendancy stable identities, names, character/node relationships and replacement relations. v3 also resolves each UnlockedBy physical PassiveSkills reference to its definition GraphId, and VisibleForAscendancy through the supplemental Ascendancy row to its stable Id, using the existing all-prerequisites DTO and allocation semantics. Only Ascendancy, UnlockedBy and VisibleForAscendancy leave the opaque-context guard. Requirement remains ClientStrings evidence, never a predicate. Whole unrenderable text, unknown extensions, armour, physical placement offsets and coordinate absence remain explicit prepared compatibility. Target group-centre translation uses fixed reference anchors; new nodes need explicit reference offsets. Compatibility fingerprints detect changes, not target applicability approval. Eligibility exclusions are exact source-bound policy, not a general release law. Physical radius is not inferred. CSD/source remain draft; no source promotion, adopted snapshot or CURRENT update. v4 combines complete CSD text with pinned ClientStrings point templates and SkillGems/BaseItemTypes skill-name grants. Three raw source fields leave only the renderability guard; whole-text compatibility still binds their original complete values through the v3 context hash. The full supplemental manifest is separately pinned and duplicate raw tables must exactly match F. Any passive buff remains whole-text compatibility until its complete effect can be represented. No partial target/non-stat fallback mixture.
